name: Honest Jace
aliases: the part of Jace that is honest
description: The first piece the Theorist carved away, a memory-prison fragment of Jace that narrates the guide and regrets the plan.

timeline.summary: Honest Jace, in a memory-prison, recounts the experiment born from trauma after the Phyrexian Invasion to build a Multiverse without monsters.
timeline.quote: An experiment ignited by our trauma after the Phyrexian Invasion of the entire Multiverse

timeline.summary: The original plan fails and Jace is unmade in the Meditation Realm, but pieces linger and rebuild him with the need to build a better Multiverse.
timeline.quote: When our original plan failed, Jace was unmade in the Meditation Realm.

timeline.summary: Jace's most stubborn self carves away the parts of himself that disagree, starting with the honest piece.
timeline.quote: He's even gone so far as to carve out the parts of himself that disagree with what he's done.

timeline.summary: The Theorist interrupts the guide, silencing the narrator and ordering the reader to forget.
timeline.quote: You will forget what you have heard.

relations.note: Honest Jace is a piece of Jace the Theorist carved away.
relations.quote: I was the first. I was the part that was honest about who we are.

pages_say.description: The first piece the Theorist carved away, a memory-prison fragment of Jace that narrates the guide and regrets the plan.
